version: 2
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    commit-message:
      prefix: chore
      include: scope
templates..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - 'feature/**'
      - 'release/**'
      - 'hotfix/**'

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      plugin_slug: ${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}
      zip_file: ${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
      php_version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.php_version }}
      php_runtime_matrix: ${{ steps.config.outputs.php_runtime_matrix }}
      php_runtime_matrix_json: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.php_runtime_matrix_json }}
      node_version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.node_version }}
      wordpress_readiness_enabled: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled }}
      wordpress_security_pack_enabled: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_security_pack_enabled }}
      github_code_scanning_upload_enabled: ${{ steps.config.outputs.github_code_scanning_upload_enabled }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Read config
        id: config
        shell: bash
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/write_config_outputs.sh project ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Resolve PHP runtime matrix
        id: matrix
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          raw='${{ steps.config.outputs.php_runtime_matrix }}'
          if [ -z "$raw" ]; then
            echo 'php_runtime_matrix_json=[]' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          json="$(printf '%s\n' "$raw" | tr ',' '\n' | sed '/^$/d' | jq -R . | jq -cs .)"
          echo "php_runtime_matrix_json=$json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.php_version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Validate repository
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_project.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Upload package artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}-package
          path: dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
          if-no-files-found: error

  secret-scan:
    name: Secret scan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install gitleaks
        run: |
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/install_lint_tools.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-tools" gitleaks
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Scan for secrets
        env:
          WP_PLUGIN_BASE_STRICT_LINTERS: 'true'
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/scan_secrets.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env"

  wordpress-readiness:
    name: WordPress readiness
    if: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled == 'true' }}
    needs:
      - validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      security-events: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.php_version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Validate WordPress readiness
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          WP_PLUGIN_BASE_SECURITY_PACK_SKIP_SEMGREP: 'true'
          WP_PLUGIN_BASE_STRICT_DEPLOY_ENV_PROTECTION: 'true'
          WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ vars.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_wordpress_readiness.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Run Semgrep security scan
        if: ${{ always() && needs.validate.outputs.wordpress_security_pack_enabled == 'true' }}
        id: semgrep
        continue-on-error: true
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-tools"
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/install_lint_tools.sh "$tools_dir" semgrep
          export PATH="$tools_dir:$PATH"
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/run_semgrep_security.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "dist/semgrep-security.sarif"

      - name: Assert Semgrep SARIF exists
        if: ${{ always() && needs.validate.outputs.wordpress_security_pack_enabled == 'true' }}
        run: test -s dist/semgrep-security.sarif

      - name: Upload Semgrep report artifact
        if: ${{ always() && needs.validate.outputs.wordpress_security_pack_enabled == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: semgrep-security-report
          path: dist/semgrep-security.sarif
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Upload Semgrep SARIF
        if: ${{ always() && needs.validate.outputs.wordpress_security_pack_enabled == 'true' && needs.validate.outputs.github_code_scanning_upload_enabled == 'true' }}
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@2892aa5e19bbd11bc0cff5427e3b750a04d9e3c2
        with:
          sarif_file: dist/semgrep-security.sarif

      - name: Fail when Semgrep reports findings
        if: ${{ always() && needs.validate.outputs.wordpress_security_pack_enabled == 'true' && steps.semgrep.outcome != 'success' }}
        run: |
          echo "Semgrep reported security findings. Review uploaded SARIF results." >&2
          exit 1

  php-runtime-smoke:
    name: PHP runtime smoke (PHP ${{ matrix.php-version }})
    if: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.php_runtime_matrix_json != '[]' }}
    needs:
      - validate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php-version: ${{ fromJson(needs.validate.outputs.php_runtime_matrix_json) }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Run PHP runtime smoke checks
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/run_php_runtime_smoke.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$BRANCH_NAME"
templates..github/workflows/finalize-release.yml:
name: finalize-release

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types:
      - closed

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: release-publication-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  release:
    name: Publish merged release
    if: >
      github.event.pull_request.merged == true &&
      github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      (startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'release/') || startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'hotfix/'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: write
      id-token: write

    environment: __PRODUCTION_ENVIRONMENT__
    env:
      WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ vars.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}
      WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ vars.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}

    steps:
      - name: Derive release version
        id: release
        env:
          HEAD_REF: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$HEAD_REF" =~ ^(release|hotfix)/([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$ ]]; then
            echo "version=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Unsupported release branch: $HEAD_REF" >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout protected default branch
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Preserve current trusted release helpers
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver"
          cp -R .wp-plugin-base/scripts "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts"
          cp -R .wp-plugin-base/docs "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/docs"

      - name: Verify merged commit is reachable from main
        env:
          EXPECTED_COMMIT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merge_commit_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_COMMIT" origin/main; then
            echo "Merged commit $EXPECTED_COMMIT is not reachable from origin/main." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED_COMMIT"

      - name: Read config
        id: config
        shell: bash
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/write_config_outputs.sh project ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.php_version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Validate WordPress readiness
        if: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled == 'true' }}
        env:
          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          WP_PLUGIN_BASE_STRICT_DEPLOY_ENV_PROTECTION: 'true'
          WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_wordpress_readiness.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Validate metadata versions
        if: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled != 'true' }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/check_versions.sh "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Lint PHP
        if: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled != 'true' }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/lint_php.sh

      - name: Lint JavaScript
        if: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled != 'true' }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/lint_js.sh

      - name: Build package
        if: ${{ steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled != 'true' }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/build_zip.sh

      - name: Generate GitHub release body
        run: bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/generate_github_release_body.sh" "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" > dist/release-body.md

      - name: Install SBOM and signing tools
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/install_release_security_tools.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-tools"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Generate package SBOM
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/generate_sbom.sh" \
            "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sbom.cdx.json"

      - name: Sign release package
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/sign_release.sh" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Verify signing identity before publication
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/verify_sigstore_bundle.sh" \
            "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sigstore.json" \
            plugin github-release "$GITHUB_API_URL"

      - name: Upload package artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}-${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          path: dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Attest package provenance
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8
        with:
          subject-path: dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}

      - name: Validate WordPress.org deploy configuration
        if: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        run: bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/validate_wordpress_org_deploy.sh" "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" ".wp-plugin-base.env" "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}"

      - name: Validate WooCommerce.com deploy configuration
        if: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        env:
          WOO_COM_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_USERNAME }}
          WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD }}
        run: bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/validate_woocommerce_com_deploy.sh" "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" ".wp-plugin-base.env" "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}"

      - name: Inspect release tag state
        id: tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          EXPECTED_COMMIT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merge_commit_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/github_git.sh" fetch --tags origin
          if ! git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/${VERSION}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ "$(git cat-file -t "refs/tags/${VERSION}")" != "tag" ]; then
            echo "Tag ${VERSION} already exists but is not an annotated tag." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          tag_commit="$(git rev-list -n 1 "${VERSION}")"
          if [ "$tag_commit" != "$EXPECTED_COMMIT" ]; then
            echo "Tag ${VERSION} already exists on ${tag_commit}, expected ${EXPECTED_COMMIT}." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Configure git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Create annotated tag locally
        if: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.exists != 'true' }}
        run: git -c tag.gpgsign=false tag -a "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" -m "Release ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Push tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        if: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.exists != 'true' }}
        run: bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/github_git.sh" push origin "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}"

      - name: Create GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          repair_args=()
          if [ "${{ steps.tag.outputs.exists }}" = "true" ]; then
            repair_args+=(--repair)
          fi
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/publish_github_release.sh" \
            --mark-latest \
            "${repair_args[@]}" \
            "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
            "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
            dist/release-body.md \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sbom.cdx.json" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Verify GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          ZIP_FILE: ${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/verify_github_release_assets.sh" \
            "$VERSION" \
            false \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sbom.cdx.json" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Install Subversion (post-publish)
        if: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y subversion

      - name: Deploy to WordPress.org (post-publish)
        id: deploy_wporg_post_publish
        if: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          SVN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SVN_PASSWORD }}
          SVN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SVN_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/deploy_wordpress_org.sh" \
            "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
            ".wp-plugin-base.env" \
            "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}"

      - name: Deploy to WooCommerce.com Marketplace (post-publish)
        id: deploy_woocommerce_post_publish
        if: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' && steps.config.outputs.woocommerce_com_product_id != '' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          WOO_COM_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_USERNAME }}
          WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/deploy_woocommerce_com.sh" \
            "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
            ".wp-plugin-base.env" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}"

      - name: Summarize channel deployment results
        if: ${{ always() }}
        id: channel_summary
        env:
          WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}
          WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}
          WPORG_POST_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.deploy_wporg_post_publish.outcome }}
          WOO_POST_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.deploy_woocommerce_post_publish.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          wporg_outcome="${WPORG_POST_OUTCOME:-skipped}"
          if [ "${WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED:-false}" != 'true' ]; then
            wporg_outcome='disabled'
          fi

          woo_outcome="${WOO_POST_OUTCOME:-skipped}"
          if [ "${WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED:-false}" != 'true' ]; then
            woo_outcome='disabled'
          fi

          failed_channels=0
          if [ "$wporg_outcome" = 'failure' ]; then
            failed_channels=$((failed_channels + 1))
          fi
          if [ "$woo_outcome" = 'failure' ]; then
            failed_channels=$((failed_channels + 1))
          fi

          echo "failed_channels=${failed_channels}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          {
            echo "### Distribution Channel Summary"
            echo
            echo "- WordPress.org: ${wporg_outcome}"
            echo "- WooCommerce.com: ${woo_outcome}"
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Enforce channel deployment success
        if: ${{ always() && steps.channel_summary.outputs.failed_channels != '0' }}
        run: |
          echo "One or more enabled distribution channels failed after GitHub release publication."
          echo "Use the manual release repair workflow and WooCommerce status workflow to complete channel repair."
          exit 1

      - name: Trigger GlotPress import
        if: ${{ steps.channel_summary.outputs.failed_channels == '0' && steps.config.outputs.glotpress_trigger_enabled == 'true' && steps.tag.outputs.exists != 'true' }}
        env:
          GLOTPRESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GLOTPRESS_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/trigger_glotpress_import.sh" \
            "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
            ".wp-plugin-base.env"

      - name: Send deployment notification
        if: ${{ steps.channel_summary.outputs.failed_channels == '0' && steps.config.outputs.deploy_notification_enabled == 'true' && steps.tag.outputs.exists != 'true' }}
        env:
          DEPLOY_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_NOTIFICATION_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/send_deploy_notification.sh" \
            "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
            ".wp-plugin-base.env"
templates..github/workflows/prepare-release.yml:
name: prepare-release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_type:
        description: 'How to derive the next release version'
        required: true
        default: patch
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major
          - custom
      version:
        description: 'Release version in x.y.z format when release type is custom'
        required: false
        type: string
      base_ref:
        description: 'Base branch for the release branch'
        required: true
        default: 'main'
        type: string

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: prepare-release-${{ inputs.base_ref }}-${{ inputs.release_type }}-${{ inputs.version || 'auto' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    name: Prepare release branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Validate base ref
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ inputs.base_ref }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! [[ "$BASE_REF" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$ ]] ||
            [[ "$BASE_REF" == refs/* ]] ||
            [[ "$BASE_REF" == pull/* ]] ||
            [[ "$BASE_REF" == *'/pull/'* ]] ||
            [[ "$BASE_REF" == *..* ]] ||
            [[ "$BASE_REF" == *"//"* ]]; then
            echo "Unsupported release base ref: $BASE_REF" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          if [ "$BASE_REF" != "main" ]; then
            encoded_ref="$(jq -nr --arg value "$BASE_REF" '$value|@uri')"
            protected="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/branches/${encoded_ref}" --jq '.protected')"
            if [ "$protected" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release base ref $BASE_REF must be main or a protected branch." >&2

        run: |
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-pr.md" <<'EOF'
          This PR was created by the local `prepare-release` workflow managed by `wp-plugin-base`.

          Included changes:
          - bump plugin metadata to `${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}`
          - add auto-generated changelog notes for `${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}`
          - update the release metadata based on the project config
          - derive the version using release type `${{ inputs.release_type }}`

          Automated checks on this PR:
          - version metadata consistency
          - release branch name matches the version bump
          - release changelog section exists
          - release changelog entry contains bullet items
          - workflow/action allowlist and permission audit
          - PHP and JavaScript syntax
          - package build

          ## Editing the changelog

          The changelog in `readme.txt` was auto-generated. Before merging:
          1. Review entries under `= ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }} =`
          2. Edit entries directly on the release branch to reword or reorder
          3. Keep each entry as a `* ` bullet with an `Add/Fix/Tweak/Update/Dev` prefix

          After merge:
          - the `finalize-release` workflow creates and pushes the annotated `${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}` tag automatically
          - the same `finalize-release` workflow publishes the GitHub release, emits a build attestation for the ZIP, and runs enabled distribution channels
          - release publication is GitHub-first; repair downstream channels post-publish with `release.yml` and `woocommerce-status.yml` when needed

      - name: Create or update release pull request
        id: cpr
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          changed_paths="$(git status --porcelain | awk '{print $2}' | paste -sd, -)"
          if [ -n "$changed_paths" ]; then
            export GIT_ADD_PATHS="$changed_paths"
          fi
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/create_or_update_pr.sh \
            "release/${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            "${{ inputs.base_ref }}" \
            "Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            "Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-pr.md"

      - name: Report prepare-release outcome
        env:
          BRANCH_EXISTS: ${{ steps.source.outputs.branch_exists }}
          OPEN_PR_EXISTS: ${{ steps.source.outputs.open_pr_exists }}
          PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull_request_number }}
          PULL_REQUEST_OPERATION: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull_request_operation }}
          PULL_REQUEST_URL: ${{ steps.cpr.outputs.pull_request_url }}
          RELEASE_BRANCH: release/${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "$PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER" ]; then
            echo "Release branch $RELEASE_BRANCH is ready."
            echo "PR #$PULL_REQUEST_NUMBER ($PULL_REQUEST_OPERATION): $PULL_REQUEST_URL"
            exit 0
          fi

          if [ "$BRANCH_EXISTS" = "true" ] && [ "$OPEN_PR_EXISTS" = "true" ]; then
            echo "Release branch $RELEASE_BRANCH already existed and no additional PR update was required."
          else
            echo "Release branch $RELEASE_BRANCH was prepared, but no pull request was created. Check the create_or_update_pr step output." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  contents: read

      contents: write
      attestations: write
      id-token: write

        id: version

        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"

            echo "Tag $tag is not a release version tag; skipping."
            echo "supported=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ -z "${BASH_REMATCH[2]:-}" ]; then
            echo "Stable tag $tag is handled by the release PR/finalize flow; skipping tag-push publication."

            exit 0

            echo "supported=true"
            echo "tag=$tag"
            echo "base=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            echo "prerelease=true"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Checkout tag
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: refs/tags/${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout current trusted release helpers

        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: main
          path: .wp-plugin-base-release-driver

          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Isolate trusted release helpers from packaged source
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        run: |

          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}

          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/github_git.sh" fetch --no-tags origin \
            '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main' \
            '+refs/heads/release/*:refs/remotes/origin/release/*' \
            '+refs/heads/hotfix/*:refs/remotes/origin/hotfix/*'

            if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$tag_commit" "$ref"; then
              trusted=true

            echo "Tag $TAG_NAME points to $tag_commit, which is not reachable from main, release/*, or hotfix/*." >&2

        id: config
        shell: bash
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/write_config_outputs.sh project ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up PHP
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240

          php-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.php_version }}

        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Validate tag metadata version
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/check_versions.sh "${{ steps.version.outputs.base }}" ".wp-plugin-base.env"

          BRANCH_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

          WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ vars.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_wordpress_readiness.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$BRANCH_NAME"

      - name: Validate and build package
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' && steps.config.outputs.wordpress_readiness_enabled != 'true' }}

          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/lint_php.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env"
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/lint_js.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env"
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/build_zip.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env"

      - name: Ensure package exists
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ ! -f "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}" ]; then
            bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/build_zip.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env"
          fi

      - name: Generate GitHub release body
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        env:
          BASE_VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.base }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          PLUGIN_NAME: ${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_name }}
          ZIP_FILE: ${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if ! bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/generate_github_release_body.sh" "$BASE_VERSION" > dist/release-body.md; then
            {
              printf '# %s %s\n\n' "$PLUGIN_NAME" "$BASE_VERSION"
              printf '## Install\n\n'
              printf "Use \`%s\` below to install or update the plugin in WordPress.\n" "$ZIP_FILE"
            } > dist/release-body.md
          fi
          if [ "$TAG_NAME" != "$BASE_VERSION" ]; then
            {
              printf '\n## Tag\n\n'
              printf "This release was published from \`%s\` and packages plugin metadata version \`%s\`.\n" "$TAG_NAME" "$BASE_VERSION"
            } >> dist/release-body.md
          fi

      - name: Install SBOM and signing tools
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/install_release_security_tools.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-tools"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Generate package SBOM
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/generate_sbom.sh" \
            "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sbom.cdx.json"

      - name: Sign release package
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/sign_release.sh" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Upload package artifact
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
        with:
          name: ${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}-${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          path: dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Attest package provenance
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8
        with:
          subject-path: dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}

      - name: Create or repair GitHub release
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ steps.version.outputs.prerelease }}
          ZIP_FILE: ${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/publish_github_release.sh" --repair --prerelease \
            "$TAG_NAME" "$TAG_NAME" dist/release-body.md \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sbom.cdx.json" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Verify GitHub release
        if: ${{ steps.version.outputs.supported == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
          PRERELEASE: ${{ steps.version.outputs.prerelease }}
          ZIP_FILE: ${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/verify_github_release_assets.sh" \
            "$TAG_NAME" \
            "$PRERELEASE" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sbom.cdx.json" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sigstore.json"

        with:
          ref: refs/tags/${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}

        with:
          ref: main
          path: .wp-plugin-base-release-driver
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Isolate trusted release helpers from packaged source
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver"
          cp -R .wp-plugin-base-release-driver/.wp-plugin-base/scripts "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts"
          cp -R .wp-plugin-base-release-driver/.wp-plugin-base/docs "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/docs"
          rm -rf .wp-plugin-base-release-driver

      - name: Verify release tag is annotated
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

      - name: Lint JavaScript

      - name: Build package

      - name: Generate GitHub release body

        if: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        env:
          WOO_COM_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_USERNAME }}
          WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD }}
        run: bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/validate_woocommerce_com_deploy.sh" "${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" ".wp-plugin-base.env" "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}"

      - name: Report skipped WordPress.org redeploy
        if: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' && env.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_ALLOW_WPORG_TAG_REDEPLOY != 'true' }}
        run: echo "Manual release recovery skips WordPress.org redeploy unless WP_PLUGIN_BASE_ALLOW_WPORG_TAG_REDEPLOY=true is set for an intentional repair of the latest repository release tag."

      - name: Install Subversion
        if: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' && env.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_ALLOW_WPORG_TAG_REDEPLOY == 'true' }}
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y subversion

      - name: Create GitHub release
        if: ${{ inputs.repair_host_assets }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/publish_github_release.sh" --repair \
            "${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            "${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            dist/release-body.md \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sbom.cdx.json" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Verify GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}
          ZIP_FILE: ${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/verify_github_release_assets.sh" \
            "$VERSION" \
            false \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sbom.cdx.json" \
            "dist/${ZIP_FILE}.sigstore.json"

      - name: Deploy to WordPress.org
        if: ${{ env.WP_ORG_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' && env.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_ALLOW_WPORG_TAG_REDEPLOY == 'true' }}
        env:
          SVN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.SVN_PASSWORD }}
          SVN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SVN_USERNAME }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/deploy_wordpress_org.sh" \
            "${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            ".wp-plugin-base.env" \
            "dist/package/${{ steps.config.outputs.plugin_slug }}"

      - name: Deploy to WooCommerce.com Marketplace
        if: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' && steps.config.outputs.woocommerce_com_product_id != '' }}
        env:
          WOO_COM_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_USERNAME }}
          WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-driver/scripts/release/deploy_woocommerce_com.sh" \
            "${{ steps.version.outputs.value }}" \
            ".wp-plugin-base.env" \
            "dist/${{ steps.config.outputs.zip_file }}"

name: simulate-release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_type:
        description: 'How to derive the simulated release version'
        required: true
        default: patch
        type: choice
        options:
          - patch
          - minor
          - major
          - custom
      version:
        description: 'Version in x.y.z format when release type is custom'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  simulate:
    name: Simulate release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Read config
        id: config
        shell: bash
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/write_config_outputs.sh project ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.php_version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.config.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Simulate release
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

            bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/release/simulate_release.sh custom "${{ inputs.version }}" ".wp-plugin-base.env"

templates..github/workflows/update-foundation.yml:
name: update-foundation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '13 6 * * 1'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

concurrency:
  group: update-foundation-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    name: Update foundation
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Read config
        id: config
        shell: bash
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/write_config_outputs.sh foundation ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Read project runtime config
        id: runtime
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/write_config_outputs.sh project ".wp-plugin-base.env" "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Set up PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240
        with:
          php-version: ${{ steps.runtime.outputs.php_version }}

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.runtime.outputs.node_version }}

      - name: Configure git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Add foundation remote
        run: |
          source .wp-plugin-base/scripts/lib/provider.sh
          git remote remove foundation >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          git remote add foundation "$(wp_plugin_base_provider_reference_git_url "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_provider }}" "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_api_base }}" "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_reference }}")"

      - name: Resolve latest compatible released version
        id: latest
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_FOUNDATION_TOKEN != '' && secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_FOUNDATION_TOKEN || github.token }}
          GITLAB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITLAB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/resolve_latest_foundation_version.sh \
            "${{ steps.config.outputs.version }}" \
            "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_reference }}" \
            "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" \
            "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_provider }}" \
            "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_api_base }}"

      - name: Install release security tools
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/release/install_release_security_tools.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-tools"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base-release-tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify foundation release provenance
        id: verify
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_FOUNDATION_TOKEN != '' && secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_FOUNDATION_TOKEN || github.token }}
          GITLAB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITLAB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          while IFS= read -r candidate_version; do
            [ -n "$candidate_version" ] || continue
            verify_output="$(mktemp)"
            verify_log="$(mktemp)"
            if bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/verify_foundation_release.sh \
              "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_reference }}" \
              "$candidate_version" \
              "$verify_output" \
              "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_provider }}" \
              "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_api_base }}" \
              "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_sigstore_issuer }}" >"$verify_log" 2>&1; then
              cat "$verify_output" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              rm -f "$verify_output" "$verify_log"
              exit 0
            fi
            cat "$verify_log" >&2
            rm -f "$verify_output" "$verify_log"
          done <<'EOF'
          ${{ steps.latest.outputs.candidates }}
          EOF

          echo "No compatible foundation release passed provenance verification." >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Clone target foundation version
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_FOUNDATION_TOKEN != '' && secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_FOUNDATION_TOKEN || github.token }}
          GITLAB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITLAB_TOKEN }}
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          rm -rf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base"
          git init "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base"
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base" remote add origin "$(git remote get-url foundation)"
          source .wp-plugin-base/scripts/lib/provider.sh
          wp_plugin_base_provider_git "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_provider }}" "${{ steps.config.outputs.release_source_api_base }}" \
            -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base" fetch --depth 1 origin "${{ steps.verify.outputs.commit_sha }}"
          git -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base" checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD

      - name: Refresh vendored foundation directory
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          rm -rf .wp-plugin-base
          mkdir -p .wp-plugin-base
          rsync -a --exclude '.git' "$RUNNER_TEMP/wp-plugin-base/" .wp-plugin-base/

      - name: Update project config
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          perl -0pi -e "s/^FOUNDATION_VERSION=.*/FOUNDATION_VERSION=${{ steps.verify.outputs.version }}/m" .wp-plugin-base.env

      - name: Regenerate managed files
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        env:
          WP_PLUGIN_BASE_ACTION_MIGRATION_MANIFEST: ${{ runner.temp }}/foundation-action-migrations.txt
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/sync_child_repo.sh

      - name: Validate updated child repository
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        run: bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_project.sh

      - name: Resolve managed staging paths
        id: managed-paths
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          managed_paths="$(
            {
              printf '%s\n' ".wp-plugin-base" || exit 1
              printf '%s\n' ".wp-plugin-base.env" || exit 1
              bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/list_managed_files.sh --mode stage ".wp-plugin-base.env" || exit 1
              ruby .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/list_migrated_action_paths.rb "$PWD" "$RUNNER_TEMP/foundation-action-migrations.txt" || exit 1
            } | awk '!seen[$0]++' | paste -sd, -
          )"
          echo "value=$managed_paths" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Write foundation update pull request body
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/foundation-update-pr.md" <<'EOF'
          This PR updates the vendored foundation and regenerates the managed workflow and documentation files.

          Updated foundation version:
          - `${{ steps.config.outputs.version }}` -> `${{ steps.verify.outputs.version }}`

          Security checks performed before proposing this update:
          - release is published and supported by the configured foundation source provider
          - tag matches the foundation semver contract
          - signed release metadata matches the authoritative source, version, and commit
          - tag commit is reachable from the foundation `main`
          - release was produced by the protected foundation release flow
          - release author is in the allowed release-author list
          - vendored code is refreshed from the verified commit SHA
          EOF

      - name: Create foundation update PR
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_PR_TOKEN != '' && secrets.WP_PLUGIN_BASE_PR_TOKEN || github.token }}
          GIT_ADD_PATHS: ${{ steps.managed-paths.outputs.value }}
        run: |
          bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/create_or_update_pr.sh \
            "chore/update-wp-plugin-base-${{ steps.verify.outputs.version }}" \
            "main" \
            "chore: update wp-plugin-base to ${{ steps.verify.outputs.version }}" \
            "chore: update wp-plugin-base to ${{ steps.verify.outputs.version }}" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/foundation-update-pr.md"

      - name: Report no update needed
        if: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.update_needed != 'true' }}
        run: echo "No compatible foundation update found."
templates..github/workflows/woocommerce-status.yml:
name: woocommerce-status

on:

  contents: read

jobs:

    env:
      WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED: ${{ vars.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

        if: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED != 'true' }}
        run: |
          echo "WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED is not true; WooCommerce.com status check is skipped."
          {
            echo "### WooCommerce.com Status"
            echo
            echo "- Status check skipped because \`WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED\` is not true."
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Check WooCommerce.com deployment status
        if: ${{ env.WOOCOMMERCE_COM_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true' }}
        env:
          WOO_COM_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_USERNAME }}
          WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.WOO_COM_APP_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set +e
          status_output="$(bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/release/check_woocommerce_com_status.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" 2>&1)"

          set -e
          echo "$status_output"
          {
            echo "### WooCommerce.com Status"
            echo
            echo '```'
            echo "$status_output"

templates..gitlab-ci.yml:
stages:
  - validate
  - test
  - maintenance
  - release

include:
  - template: Jobs/SAST.gitlab-ci.yml
  - template: Jobs/Secret-Detection.gitlab-ci.yml

.wp_plugin_base_runtime:
  rules: &wp_plugin_base_rules
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH'
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_TAG'
  image: $WP_PLUGIN_BASE_GITLAB_RUNTIME_IMAGE
  before_script:
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/prepare_gitlab_runtime.sh .wp-plugin-base.env

.wp_plugin_base_release_runtime:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_runtime

variables:
  GIT_DEPTH: '0'
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: 'true'
  WP_PLUGIN_BASE_GITLAB_RUNTIME_IMAGE: ubuntu:24.04@sha256:c4a8d5503dfb2a3eb8ab5f807da5bc69a85730fb49b5cfca2330194ebcc41c7b
  WP_PLUGIN_BASE_GITLAB_BOOTSTRAP_APT: 'true'

validate:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_runtime
  stage: validate
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH'
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_TAG'
  script:
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_project.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "${CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME}"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - dist/

readiness:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_runtime
  stage: test
  needs: [validate]
  script:
    - |
      . .wp-plugin-base/scripts/lib/load_config.sh
      wp_plugin_base_load_config .wp-plugin-base.env
      if wp_plugin_base_is_true "$WORDPRESS_READINESS_ENABLED"; then
        bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/validate_wordpress_readiness.sh .wp-plugin-base.env
      fi

runtime_matrix_config:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_runtime
  stage: validate
  script:
    - mkdir -p dist
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/ci/generate_gitlab_runtime_pipeline.sh .wp-plugin-base.env > dist/runtime-pipeline.yml
  artifacts:
    paths: [dist/runtime-pipeline.yml]

runtime_matrix:
  rules: *wp_plugin_base_rules
  stage: test
  needs: [runtime_matrix_config]
  trigger:
    include:
      - artifact: dist/runtime-pipeline.yml
        job: runtime_matrix_config
    strategy: depend


prepare_release:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_runtime
  stage: maintenance
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
      when: manual
    - when: never
  script:
    - test -n "${RELEASE_TYPE:-}" || { echo "Set RELEASE_TYPE to patch, minor, major, or custom when starting the pipeline."; exit 1; }
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/release/prepare_release_change_request.sh "${RELEASE_TYPE}" "${RELEASE_VERSION:-}" "${BASE_REF:-main}" ".wp-plugin-base.env"

update_foundation:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_runtime
  stage: maintenance
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH'
      when: manual
    - when: never
  script:
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/release/install_release_security_tools.sh "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.release-tools"
    - export PATH="$CI_PROJECT_DIR/.release-tools:$PATH"
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/update/run_foundation_update.sh ".wp-plugin-base.env" "${BASE_REF:-main}"

release:
  extends: .wp_plugin_base_release_runtime
  stage: release
  resource_group: release-publication
  id_tokens:
    SIGSTORE_ID_TOKEN:
      aud: sigstore
  environment:
    name: __PRODUCTION_ENVIRONMENT__
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_COMMIT_TAG =~ /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$/'
  script:
    - bash .wp-plugin-base/scripts/release/run_gitlab_release.sh "${CI_COMMIT_TAG}" ".wp-plugin-base.env"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    paths:
      - dist/
